# 001 — Keep the shop handbook in one shared folder
**Date** 2026-10-02 · **Status** accepted · **Decided by** founder ("one place that every helper can read")

**Context.** Supplier notes lived in three inboxes and a spreadsheet.
New helpers could not find the packing rules.

**Decision.** `Acme-Org/widget-brain`: plain markdown, synced to the shop laptop and the cloud drive, read by all
agents; each adds its weekly notes as commits. Sales figures stay in the shop system.

**Consequences.** Every agent starts from `HANDBOOK.md`. The keeper agent keeps it current. Passwords never go in.
